newsitem.title: USA: First Bancshares Inc Q2 Dec 31 net rises.
newsitem.headline: First Bancshares Inc Q2 Dec 31 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Q2 1996 net includes $119,000 after-tax gain from sales of investments and a $16,000 after-tax loss on the write-down of property. Excluding the items, net income for the quarter would have been $421,000.

NOTE: Net income for the six months ended December 31, 1996 includes a $370,000 after-tax one-time SAIF assessment charge. Excluding the two quarterly items and the SAIF charge, net income for the six months would have been $824,000.
NOTE: As of December 31, 1996, total assets were $157 million versus $140 million in 1995.
